description: We are tackling a real challenge using NASA Open Data. Everyone's ideas are heard, and everyone gets a real role. You'll learn new skills while building something meaningful. We need coders, designers and researchers or presenters who are able to explain science clearly. Beginners welcome! Curiosity and teamwork matter most.
summary:
Mars Base Buddies is an interactive Mars colony survival and educational simulation game that introduces players to the challenges of human settlement on Mars. Combining space exploration, environmental simulations and STEM education, the game provides an engaging learning experience.

Players undertake a survival mission consisting of exactly 10 Sols (Martian days), completing objectives while responding to environmental hazards such as dust storms and solar flares. They explore specialised facilities, including a Radiation Shelter, Research Laboratory and Solar Weather Monitoring Facility, to understand astronaut safety and scientific research.

A key feature is its integration with NASA's DONKI API, providing access to authentic space-weather information, including solar flares, coronal mass ejections (CMEs) and solar energetic particles (SEPs).

After completing Sol 10, players receive a mission evaluation, achievements and the opportunity to replay the campaign.

Ultimately, Mars Base Buddies aims to make space science accessible, encourage critical thinking and inspire interest in humanity's future exploration of Mars.
details:
10-Sol Survival Campaign: Complete a structured 10-Martian-day mission with objectives and increasing environmental challenges.

-Environmental Hazards: Experience simulated dust storms, solar flares and radiation-related threats.

-Interactive Facilities: Explore specialised facilities, including the Radiation Shelter, Research Laboratory and Solar Weather Monitoring Facility.

-Radiation Monitoring: Understand radiation exposure and the importance of astronaut protection.

- NASA DONKI API Integration: Retrieve authentic NASA space-weather records, including solar flares (FLR), coronal mass ejections (CMEs) and solar energetic particles (SEPs).

- Real-Time Data Exploration: Browse available NASA records using 7-day and 30-day filters, refresh data and access original NASA sources.

- Mission Management: Track mission objectives, environmental alerts, colony conditions and activity logs.

- Performance Evaluation: Receive a final mission assessment based on survival performance.

- Achievement System: Earn achievements throughout the survival campaign.

- Replay System: Restart the complete 10-Sol mission and improve previous performance.
